title: AI & Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, build, and deploy intelligent algorithms, neural networks, and generative AI models that power smart devices, medical diagnostics, autonomous vehicles, and automated decision engines.

timeline.task: Build basic coding logic with Python/Scratch & excel in Mathematics.
Choose PCM, prepare for JEE Main/Advanced, learn Calculus & basic ML algorithms.
B.Tech in CSE / AI-DS / Data Science, contribute to open-source & internships.
Join top AI labs, tech unicorns, or build deep-tech startups.

recommendedBooks: Hands-On Machine Learning by Aurélien Géron

title: Medical Doctor (MBBS) & Specialist Surgeon
description: Diagnose human diseases, perform lifesaving surgeries, prescribe medical treatments, and advance clinical healthcare research across cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, and oncology.

timeline.task: Focus on Biology, Chemistry, and scientific observation skills.
Choose PCB, prepare rigorously for NEET-UG exam.
Complete MBBS degree including 1-year mandatory rotating internship.
Clear NEET-PG for MD / MS specialization in Cardiology, Surgery, or Pediatrics.

title: Chartered Accountant (CA) & Financial Strategist
description: Manage corporate auditing, taxation, financial planning, merger analysis, and corporate compliance for top Indian business conglomerates, MNCs, and public institutions.

timeline.task: Develop strong mathematical logic and analytical problem-solving.
Choose Commerce stream, study Accountancy, Business Studies, and Economics.
Clear CA Foundation, CA Intermediate, 2-year Articleship, and CA Final exam by ICAI.
Join Big 4 auditing firms (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) or corporate finance teams.

topColleges: ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India)
recommendedBooks: Corporate Tax Planning by VK Singhania

title: Corporate & Intellectual Property Lawyer
description: Draft commercial contracts, navigate international business law, resolve corporate disputes, manage mergers & acquisitions, and protect intellectual property patents.

timeline.task: Engage in Model UN (MUN), public speaking, and reading general awareness & polity.
Prepare for CLAT / AILET entrance exams across Arts, Commerce, or Science.
5-Year Integrated B.A. LL.B (Hons) or B.B.A. LL.B from National Law Universities (NLUs).
Clear All India Bar Examination (AIBE) & join top tier legal firms.

recommendedBooks: Learning the Law by Glanville Williams
We, The People by Nani Palkhivala

title: UX/UI & Product Designer
description: Blend user psychology, visual elegance, and software interaction design to create intuitive mobile apps, modern web platforms, and augmented reality interfaces.

timeline.task: Develop sketching skills, explore digital art tools & design fundamentals.
Prepare for NID DAT / UCEED entrance exams & build a creative portfolio.
B.Des in Interaction Design or Product Design from premier institutes.
Join product teams at Swiggy, CRED, Apple, or Google.

recommendedBooks: The Design of Everyday Things by Don Norman
Don't Make Me Think by Steve Krug

title: IAS / IPS Officer & Public Administrator
description: Formulate national development policies, administer district governance, maintain public order, and lead socio-economic transformation projects for the Government of India.

timeline.task: Read daily newspapers, build General Knowledge, and master Social Sciences.
Build essay writing skills & maintain academic excellence in any stream.
Complete Bachelor's degree (BA/B.Sc/B.Tech) and start UPSC CSE preparation.
Clear UPSC CSE Prelims, Mains (9 papers), and Personality Test Interview.

entranceExams: UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims, Mains, Interview)
recommendedBooks: India's Struggle for Independence by Bipan Chandra

title: Clinical Psychologist & Mental Health Counsellor
description: Assess cognitive behavior, provide psychotherapy for anxiety and trauma, conduct clinical counseling, and promote mental health wellness across schools, hospitals, and private practice.

timeline.task: Explore human behavior books and communication skills.
Choose Psychology as an elective subject in Humanities / Science.
B.A./B.Sc in Psychology followed by M.A./M.Sc in Clinical Psychology.
Complete M.Phil in Clinical Psychology from RCI-recognized institutes for practice license.

recommendedBooks: Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman
Man's Search for Meaning by Viktor Frankl

title: Digital Journalist & Media Strategist
description: Investigate real news stories, produce digital investigative video reports, publish data journalism pieces, and manage content strategy across multi-platform digital media houses.

timeline.task: Write articles, school newsletter pieces, and practice public debates.
Focus on English, Social Sciences, Media Studies, or Mass Communication.
B.A. in Journalism & Mass Communication (BJMC) or Media Studies.
Join newsrooms (NDTV, The Hindu, Scroll, Quint) as junior reporter or editor.

recommendedBooks: Everybody Loves a Good Drought by P. Sainath
youtubeChannels: Cut The Clutter by Shekhar Gupta
